heading: What Exactly is the Gut-Skin Axis?
alt: The gut-skin axis: dysbiosis drives inflammation, markers cross a compromised gut lining, and the skin barrier is disrupted

heading: Common Skin Conditions Linked to Gut Health
alt: Acne, eczema and psoriasis, and rosacea are each linked to gut health, with rosacea tied to SIBO

heading: Signs Your Gut Might Be Affecting Your Skin
alt: Gut signs showing on skin: frequent bloating, food sensitivities, sudden reactions to familiar products, sugar cravings

heading: How to Support Your Gut for Radiant Skin
alt: Support gut health with probiotics from fermented foods, prebiotic fibre, and 7 to 9 hours of sleep to lower cortisol

heading: What is Estrogen Dominance?
alt: Estrogen regulates the menstrual cycle, fat distribution, insulin sensitivity, bone density and cholesterol

heading: Hormonal Weight Gain
alt: When estrogen is imbalanced fat storage rises, muscle mass falls, metabolism slows and water retention increases

heading: Correcting the Balance
alt: Restoring estrogen balance through liver support, nutrition and strength training, and BHRT under medical supervision

heading: When to Talk to a Healthcare Provider
alt: See a provider for persistent unexplained weight gain, severe fatigue, heavy periods, mood instability or stalled weight loss

heading: What is "Brain Fog" and How Does Testosterone Affect the Mind?
alt: The brain is dense with testosterone receptors, concentrated in the hippocampus, and under-fired when levels drop

heading: Neurological Impact of Low T: Why Hormones Matter for Mental Clarity
alt: Testosterone acts as a neuroprotective agent and influences both spatial memory and verbal memory

heading: Recognizing Symptoms: Beyond Just "Feeling Tired"
alt: Low testosterone brain fog: trouble focusing, short-term memory gaps, mood changes, fatigue after sleep, lost motivation

heading: Advanced Testing: Getting to the Root of the Problem
alt: Total testosterone counts everything in the blood including protein-bound; free testosterone is the active usable portion
